materials.writer_ids: NONE; material_id and variant are wrapper identifiers, not writers
materials.reuse: cached readings reused; no new neural read; not a new replication

evidence_unit.content: polarity of the plan (designed label pole b in {0,1})
evidence_unit.observation_law: E[b, status, c] per reader version and family; source family only for the frozen law

downstream_link_check: F16 text-T1 route links the binary channel to a continuous F04 contrast via a numeric-source sigma and calibrates on the validation family; not used as primary (borrowed continuous unit; split conflict). Primary = finite evidence-mixture world below.

world.target: pi_u = P(pole = 1 | qualified own report, author u); secondary kappa = qualified share
world.selection_law: status actual/negated each kappa/2; quoted/hypothetical each (1-kappa)/2; pole|qualified ~ Bern(pi_u); pole|unqualified ~ Bern(.5) independent of author
world.material_draw: uniform over the 4 wrapper variants of the event's (pole,status) class in the scored family
world.note: simulated authors/histories are not people; material count stays 96

arms.naive_uncalibrated: reader categories taken as truth; Beta(1+pos,1+neg) over reader-qualified events
arms.calibrated_dirichlet: PRIMARY; 200 Dirichlet(counts+.5) channel draws (row-independent working law), mixture posterior
arms.calibrated_variant_bootstrap: 200 paired wrapper-variant resamples (+.5 smoothing), cluster sensitivity
arms.wrong_reader_law: this reader's categories scored with the other reader's source Dirichlet law (counterexample)
arms.matched_observation: PRIVILEGED reference: true (pole,status) per event, Beta posterior

estimators.lexical_source_readings: leave-one-variant-out refit with f08.fit_reader constants (word1-2/char2-4 TFIDF max5000, Ridge 1, logistic C1); in-sample cache kept as ablation
estimators.interval: equal-tailed 95% from the mixture marginal posterior on the pi grid
estimators.null_evidence: author with no events -> status no_events, prior only, never an observed neutral trait

positive_construction_per_reader (primar.P1_nonconstant: SD of posterior means >= .056 (one quarter of design SD .224)
positive_construction_per_reader (primar.P2_held_contrasts: application-family materials: qualified pole-score contrast b1-b0 > 0 and qualification-score direction (qualified - unqualified) > 0, both with material-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
positive_construction_per_reader (primar.P4_downstream_noninferior: paired author-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of MSE(primary) - MSE(naive) <= 0
positive_construction_per_reader (primar.P5_cold_replay: bundle CLI reproduces primary scores, max abs diff <= 1e-12

acceptance_frozen.positive_overall: at least one reader passes P1-P5
acceptance_frozen.transport_claim_separate: primary coverage >= .932 (lower binomial 95% bound around .95 at n=600) and bias CI covering 0 at every kappa; failure = wrapper-family transport boundary, not renamed

bounds: one BLAS thread; no neural call, API, generation, download, private data, commit or worktree
